For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to…
that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand…
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will…
“Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give…

Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know…
Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people, and for the cities of our God; and may Yahweh do what seems good to…

Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

translations.bsb: “I am about to go the way of all the earth. So be strong and prove yourself a man.
